propositions: The plan-review gate has no criterion to check whether a proposed change is actually needed (the FixedBench over-action gap); plans that add mechanisms without establishing necessity are not flagged.
Bug tickets short-circuit to bare exempt-PASS in the plan-review gate with zero substantive review (verified on bug 5886: REVIEW_RESULT was exempt with llm_calls=0).
A new pass-1 advisory criterion 'necessity' is needed that judges whether a plan demonstrates the change is needed by establishing current behavior reproduction or motivation.
The bug review tier must be lightweight (DET floor + necessity probe only, all advisory) and prevent bugs from short-circuiting entirely, enabling substantive optional review without blocking.

Both the necessity criterion and bug-tier logic must integrate into the existing advisory-criterion pattern (routing entry, CANONICAL_LLM registration, rubric, auto-monitoring via standing recorder) rather than a bespoke engine path.
